long_biography.plain_text:
The Russian Helicopters appointment moved Mikheyev from export management into direct responsibility for a national manufacturing group. Rostec charged the new chief executive with improving profitability and extending the holding's international reach. The assignment required closer coordination of design, production and marketing across a consolidated helicopter business.

Rostec subsequently appointed him to lead Rosoboronexport, the state-controlled company coordinating foreign sales of Russian defence and dual-use technologies. The post brought together manufacturer relationships, long-cycle negotiations and export administration. As deputy chairman of the Russian Engineering Union, Mikheyev has also worked across the broader network of engineering enterprises involved in international industrial programmes.
